comments.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 3116 (commit 6080140e7af; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved, no advisories). make verify before the push: 17 failed, 19745 passed, 107 skipped; all 17 failures are the known pandoc set under tests/unit/reconciler, 0 elsewhere, 0 ERROR lines.

Premise checked first: the 2026-09-21 Windows job log (run 35551741150, job 106187634058) ends this test with SshKeygenUnavailable: ssh-keygen (OpenSSH) not found; SSHSIG requires OpenSSH >= 8.9, so the ticket's cause holds.

Change (tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py only): _skip_without_sshsig() calls sshsig.ensure_available() and turns only SshKeygenUnavailable into pytest.skip, with a reason that names the version and the 8.9 floor and says per-store opcert key isolation is not asserted. It is called first in test_opcert_signing_key_is_isolated_per_store and, after its existing POSIX-mode skip (reason citing 47d8-baf8-2348-45c9, unchanged), in test_copied_opcert_signing_keys_are_owner_only. No module-level skip. 5 helper tests pin it: skips for a missing ssh, 8.8 and 7.9; does not skip at 8.9; lets any other exception through.

Evidence. Shim = an executable named ssh first on PATH whose banner is OpenSSH_8.8p1, OpenSSL 3.0.2.
1. Isolation module under the shim, BEFORE: 2 failed, 12 passed (the two tests above fail with SshKeygenUnavailable, the Windows failure reproduced on macOS). AFTER (2026-10-25 22:04 PDT): 17 passed, 2 skipped, reason 'OpenSSH 8.8 is too old for SSHSIG; requires >= 8.9; per-store opcert key isolation is not asserted here'. The 17 are the 12 unchanged tests plus the 5 helper tests.
2. Real ssh (OpenSSH 10.3) after: 19 passed (14 original + 5 new).
3. Merged main (HEAD 6080140e7af), 2026-10-25 23:43 PDT: 8.8 shim -> 17 passed, 2 skipped; real ssh -> 19 passed.
Note on the plan's wording: the acceptance criteria said '14 passed' and '12 passing in both'; with the 5 helper tests added the real counts are 19 passed (real ssh) and 17 passed plus 2 skipped (8.8 shim). The 12 unchanged tests pass in both runs.
4. Only tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py changed for this ticket.

Scope: the same condition fails 46 more tests in 4 other modules on the Windows sweep (measured with the 8.8 shim: 50 of 97 across 5 modules). Those are tracked in coldwater-dermoid-rattail (4803-05ae-23bc-4403), whose probe fix landed as 3115; after it the 5 modules pass under a Windows-banner shim. Unverified: the real Windows runner's behaviour; this host is macOS. The skip stays as the fallback for a runner without OpenSSH 8.9.

compiled_state.description:
## Observation
Found while verifying d724 AC10 on Windows sweep run 35551741150 (2026-09-21). `tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py::test_opcert_signing_key_is_isolated_per_store` fails on the Windows runner. The runner has no OpenSSH that `rebar.attest.sshsig.ssh_keygen_version()` can find, and op-cert signing needs OpenSSH 8.9 or newer. Not a d724 defect class.

## Checked (2026-10-25)
The job log for that run (job 106187634058) ends the test with `rebar.attest.sshsig.SshKeygenUnavailable: ssh-keygen (OpenSSH) not found; SSHSIG requires OpenSSH >= 8.9`, so the ticket's cause holds. The same cause fails 24 distinct tests in 5 modules in that log (this test, 11 in test_opcert_local_verify_binding.py, 9 in test_attestation_invalidation.py, 2 in test_opcert_binding_thread_propagation_ff4a.py, 1 in test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py). Three other opcert modules already skip on the same condition with a module-level `_SSH_OK` probe built on `sshsig.ensure_available()`.

## Decision (user, 2026-10-25)
Skip the test with a clear reason when OpenSSH is older than 8.9 or missing; do not change the Windows workflow. Per-store key isolation stays untested on Windows until a runner has OpenSSH 8.9 or newer. The user also chose to fix the version probe itself for Windows banners, tracked in coldwater-dermoid-rattail (4803-05ae-23bc-4403); this skip stays as the fallback for runners that really lack OpenSSH 8.9.

## Plan
In `tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py` only:
1. Add a small helper `_skip_without_sshsig()` that calls `sshsig.ensure_available()` and turns `sshsig.SshKeygenUnavailable` (and only that) into `pytest.skip` with a reason that names the exception text and says per-store opcert key isolation is not asserted.
2. Call it first in `test_opcert_signing_key_is_isolated_per_store`, and in `test_copied_opcert_signing_keys_are_owner_only` AFTER its existing POSIX-mode skip (that test skips on Windows before it reaches ssh, citing 47d8-baf8-2348-45c9, and that reason must not change; on a POSIX host with an old ssh it fails the same way, 2 of the 14 tests in this module fail under an OpenSSH 8.8 shim). No module-level skip: the other 12 tests in this module do not need ssh.
3. Add unit tests of the helper: missing ssh (version None) and an old one (8, 8) skip with the 8.9 floor in the reason; (8, 9) does not skip; any other exception propagates.
Red proof first: with a PATH shim whose `ssh -V` prints `OpenSSH_8.8p1`, run the real test; before the change it fails with SshKeygenUnavailable (the Windows failure, reproduced on this host), after it reports skipped.

Out of scope: the 48 other tests in 4 modules that fail under the same shim (coldwater-dermoid-rattail covers the probe fix that should make them run), provisioning OpenSSH on the runner, and `ssh_keygen_version()` probing `ssh -V` rather than `ssh-keygen -V`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] With a PATH shim whose `ssh -V` reports OpenSSH 8.8, both tests (`test_opcert_signing_key_is_isolated_per_store` and `test_copied_opcert_signing_keys_are_owner_only`) are skipped with a reason naming the 8.9 floor, where before the change the same run failed with SshKeygenUnavailable (checked: both runs of `pytest tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py -rs` recorded in a ticket comment, 2 failed before and 2 skipped after, the other 12 passing in both).
- [x] With this host's real ssh (OpenSSH 10.3) both tests still run and pass (checked: the same command without the shim reports 14 passed).
- [x] The helper skips for a missing ssh and for 8.8, proceeds for 8.9, and lets any other exception propagate (checked: the new helper tests pass).
- [x] Only `tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py` changes, and no other test in it changes behaviour (checked: `git diff --stat` lists that one file; collected node ids differ only by the new tests).
- [x] `make verify` shows no failure outside the known pandoc set, and the Gerrit change is `Verified +1`.

## Testing
```
pytest tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py -q
make verify
```
